												value = get_hw_next_value(value, hw_write_enable, hw_write_data, hw_set, hw_clear);

      
												get_next_value = value;

      
											end

      
										endfunction

      
										localparam [0:0] SW_READABLE = 1'd1;

      
										wire [1:0] sw_update;

      
										reg sw_write_done;

      
										wire hw_update;

      
										reg [1:0] trigger;

      
										reg [0:0] value;

      
										wire [0:0] read_data;

      
										assign rggen.u_block_1.g_register_file_2.g[_gv_i_6].g_register_file_0.g_register_1.g_bit_field_0.g[_gv_j_6].bit_field_sub_if.read_data = read_data & i_mask;

      
										assign rggen.u_block_1.g_register_file_2.g[_gv_i_6].g_register_file_0.g_register_1.g_bit_field_0.g[_gv_j_6].bit_field_sub_if.value = value;

      
										assign o_write_trigger = trigger[0];

      
										assign o_read_trigger = trigger[1];

      
										assign o_value = value & i_mask;

      
										assign o_value_unmasked = value;

      
										assign sw_update = get_sw_update(rggen.u_block_1.g_register_file_2.g[_gv_i_6].g_register_file_0.g_register_1.g_bit_field_0.g[_gv_j_6].bit_field_sub_if.valid, rggen.u_block_1.g_register_file_2.g[_gv_i_6].g_register_file_0.g_register_1.g_bit_field_0.g[_gv_j_6].bit_field_sub_if.read_mask, i_sw_write_enable, rggen.u_block_1.g_register_file_2.g[_gv_i_6].g_register_file_0.g_register_1.g_bit_field_0.g[_gv_j_6].bit_field_sub_if.write_mask, sw_write_done);

      
										assign hw_update = get_hw_update(i_hw_write_enable, i_hw_set, i_hw_clear);

      
										if (1) begin : g_sw_write_done

      
											wire [1:1] sv2v_tmp_2B793;

      
											assign sv2v_tmp_2B793 = 1'sb0;

      
											always @(*) sw_write_done = sv2v_tmp_2B793;

      
										end

      
										if (1) begin : g_write_trigger

      
											wire [1:1] sv2v_tmp_45ED3;

      
											assign sv2v_tmp_45ED3 = 1'sb0;

      
											always @(*) trigger[0] = sv2v_tmp_45ED3;

      
										end

      
										if (1) begin : g_read_trigger

      
											wire [1:1] sv2v_tmp_7C982;

      
											assign sv2v_tmp_7C982 = 1'sb0;

      
											always @(*) trigger[1] = sv2v_tmp_7C982;

      
										end

      
										if (STORAGE) begin : g_value

      
											wire [0:0] value_next;

      
											assign value_next = get_next_value(value, sw_update, rggen.u_block_1.g_register_file_2.g[_gv_i_6].g_register_file_0.g_register_1.g_bit_field_0.g[_gv_j_6].bit_field_sub_if.write_mask, rggen.u_block_1.g_register_file_2.g[_gv_i_6].g_register_file_0.g_register_1.g_bit_field_0.g[_gv_j_6].bit_field_sub_if.write_data, i_hw_write_enable, i_hw_write_data, i_hw_set, i_hw_clear);

      
											always @(posedge i_clk or negedge i_rst_n)

      
												if (!i_rst_n)

      
													value <= INITIAL_VALUE;

      
												else if ((sw_update[0] || sw_update[1]) || hw_update)

      
													value <= value_next;

      
										end

      
										else begin : g_value

      
											wire [1:1] sv2v_tmp_5ACD1;

      
											assign sv2v_tmp_5ACD1 = i_value;

      
											always @(*) value = sv2v_tmp_5ACD1;

      
										end

      
										if (!SW_READABLE) begin : g_read_data

      
											assign read_data = 1'sb0;

      
										end

      
										else if (EXTERNAL_READ_DATA) begin : g_read_data

      
											assign read_data = i_value;

      
										end

      
										else begin : g_read_data

      
											assign read_data = value;

      
										end

      
									end

      
									assign u_bit_field.i_clk = i_clk;

      
									assign u_bit_field.i_rst_n = i_rst_n;

      
									assign u_bit_field.i_sw_write_enable = 1'sb1;

      
									assign u_bit_field.i_hw_write_enable = 1'sb0;

      
									assign u_bit_field.i_hw_write_data = 1'sb0;

      
									assign u_bit_field.i_hw_set = 1'sb0;

      
									assign u_bit_field.i_hw_clear = 1'sb0;

      
									assign u_bit_field.i_value = 1'sb0;

      
									assign u_bit_field.i_mask = 1'sb1;

      
									assign o_register_file_2_register_file_0_register_1_bit_field_0[(i * 2) + j] = u_bit_field.o_value;

      
								end

      
							end

      
						end

      
					end

      
				end

      
			end

      
		end

      
	endgenerate

      
	assign u_block_1.i_clk = clk;

      
	assign u_block_1.i_rst_n = rst_n;

      
	initial _sv2v_0 = 0;

      
endmodule
